description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions related to testing npm package installations, including mocking spawn results, verifying integrity, and handling npm metadata in a test environment.

classes.name: InstallResultLike
classes.description: Type representing the result of an installation attempt, indicating success or failure with an optional error message.

classes.name: NpmPackMetadata
classes.description: Type detailing npm package metadata such as id, name, version, filename, integrity, and shasum.

classes.name: SpawnResult
classes.description: Type imported from '../process/exec.js' representing the result of a spawned process, including exit code, stdout, stderr, and other process info.

methods.name: export function createSuccessfulSpawnResult(stdout = ""): SpawnResult { createSuccessfulSpawnResult
methods.description: Generates a mock SpawnResult indicating a successful command execution with optional stdout content.

methods.name: export async function expectUnsupportedNpmSpec( expectUnsupportedNpmSpec
methods.description: Asserts that installing a specified npm package spec results in an unsupported spec error.

methods.name: export function mockNpmPackMetadataResult( mockNpmPackMetadataResult
methods.description: Mocks the implementation of a command run to return specific npm package metadata.

methods.name: export function expectIntegrityDriftRejected(params: { expectIntegrityDriftRejected
methods.description: Verifies that an integrity drift rejection handler is called with correct parameters and that the install result indicates failure.

methods.name: export async function expectInstallUsesIgnoreScripts(params: { expectInstallUsesIgnoreScripts
methods.description: Checks that an npm install call correctly uses the --ignore-scripts flag and resolves successfully.
